answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 636 Country: India Title: I want to know tat during Qasr is it necessary to pray two rakat of sunnat and two rakat of farz namaz of fajr or only farz of fajr. Question: I want to know tat during Qasr is it necessary to pray two rakat of sunnat and two rakat of farz namaz of fajr or only farz of fajr. Answer ID: 636 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 613/J) The two Sunnah Rakats of Fajr Salah are much more important than other Sunnah Salahs. Therefore, one should offer these two Rakats of Sunnah in Fajr if there is no hurry or any problem during journey. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
